@types/node.reason: Type definitions for Node's built-in modules, for type-checking the source.

typescript.reason: The compiler and type checker for the source.

tsx.reason: Runs the dependency policy, which is written in TypeScript, without a build step.

esbuild.reason: Turns TypeScript into JavaScript for tsx.

@esbuild/*.reason: esbuild's prebuilt program, one package for each platform. The lockfile lists them all; npm installs only the one for your machine.

fsevents.reason: Lets tsx watch files on macOS. Optional, and installed on macOS only.

undici-types.reason: Type definitions for Node's built-in fetch, used by @types/node.
